cohort: The study included 120 postpartum women recruited from two accredited baby-friendly hospitals in southern Taiwan.
finding: Women with cesarean births experienced higher postpartum fatigue, which was correlated with greater difficulty in baby-care activities and weaker maternal-infant attachment.
mod_finding: Women who experienced a cesarean birth had higher postpartum fatigue scores than women who had given birth vaginally.
cross-section timing: in the first 2 to 3 days postpartum
